title: Best resource for creating Mobile Game - 2D with 3D elements, card based game
author: CanBeUsedAnywhere
selftext:
A friend of mine and I went to college over a decade ago for game programming. We had a game we had designed through our final year and put it in our student showcase. We could never go any further with it, because it was based on a copyrighted IP. Then life happened, and neither of us are in our field of choice. 

I would love to go back and recreate what we made, but of course, switch out the IP for our own inspired art. However for actually creating the game, we are so far behind, and remember pretty much nothing lol.

The game would be a 2d mobile game with 3d elements to the game. It is similar in style to [WWESupercard](https://www.google.com/search?client=firefox-b-d&hs=tLRB&sca_esv=56369a3c6dc66eb1&sxsrf=APpeQnsWcnPqnsnuMTaM_71-WZIo70COWw:1791423654614&udm=2&fbs=ABfTbFVyMZGZf1hfvX9uKjN_-G8cqCQj_06QnZs315LoFmPf5bBLHMJ0vMQmTbuI72DM7jnxvATrUU2Yg9dwuUGnsUHcA8ltRxGSueAm4xbJB7-U9Vk4K2G3aCoTcvC5pL-W3Bc4wKvyblIDvW9t3J41edOYhCyumrIO3nro7L99GH8kliwMVqQ0hvbksXIL7xFJBI_8mwByDhHJj3T0-O3ElCMyZrfalw&q=wwe+supercard&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwixzsyUpamXAxVDFTQIHTThEmQQtKgLegQIHBAB&biw=1856&bih=928&dpr=2.07#ip=1) with it being a card based battler. However, with our own take on evolution of the cards, as well as more rpg elements. But for [UI and basic game play](https://www.gamerevolution.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/gallery/697_wwe-supercard/wwe-supercard-2.jpg), that would be the most similar. 

What are the options for creating this with as little manual elements as possible. Neither of us have time on our hands to spend a lot of time on it, so I would like to avoid relearning Unity and trying to figure out all the aspects of connecting the elements together. 

Best i can tell, there are no local models that can just generate games based on prompts. I see that there are things you connect to Godot and Unity that might help, but not exactly sure how they work, and again feels like we'll have to learn the programs. 

Our end goal is to just create it, be able to play against each other, and maybe publish it to an app store to say we officially created the game. 

Is Claude about the only option? can it make the games for android/ios or only pc and or web based? Can it do PvP? If the game is meant to upload players card inventories to the server to use against other players (so my card inventory is uploaded, and if someone playing runs into me, they play against my cards) can Claude set that up?

Would we expect a regular subscription to be able to do what we want, or will we have to buy something more? Is it possible to collaborate on projects? Like can we share a sign in, and log in at different times to update the game and add new features?

Both very new to AI for anything besides asking copilot to provide some excel formulas/VB and generating some images/clips locally with comfyui

Are there other options besides Claude that can do similar?

comments.author: ProbablyDoesntLikeU
comments.body: Sounds like Godot is a clear winner here

comments.author: I_Like_emo_grills
comments.body:
Claude or Chatgpt codex + Godot + your art program of choice

you can connect claude through mcp to Godot and art programs its really easy and you just need to understand basic stuff to make it work nothing crazy 

 Claude opus 5.5 and Codex Sol 6.1 and Astra ( although it consumed more tokens than claude) can create almost any game you think about , I have already made 2 games with both fully 3D games with animation and polished gameplay by using AI + Godot + Blender , both programs connected to my AI and the AI does all the work inside them 

It can do Pc , Mobile , Browser - you name it lol 

Online and multiplayer stuff I it can do (saw other people projects) but I have not personally tried it yet in that section

For me personally the 20$ Sub was enough not sure for your project , some people end up buying the 100$ one or more depends on your token usage since it has limits on how much you can use it weekly (even then I would still recommend it the speed and time it does things is insane)

not sure about the sharing accounts but yeah you can collaborate and share stuff through github 

Chatgpt Sol 6.1 and Astra can do what Claude opus 5.5 does but they in my experience consume a lot of tokens
